Chapter 6858: Because They Are Seeds

Chapter 6858: Because They Are Seeds

“Buzz.” Li Qiye waved and Heaventrove Mountain shrank, falling into his palm.

“This is what you were looking for?” Li Qiye asked the bear.

He stared at it and scratched his head: “If this is all my ambition is, then yes. However, I want to go further and as you have said, it’s a potential calamity.”

“The heavenly treasures are great but not always suitable, definitely not as your legacy artifact.” Li Qiye said.

“I don’t want it, I’ll find something else. Moreover, I’m just a little immortal and there is no rush.” He said.

Due to his master, he had seen everything. In fact, he had his master’s legacy with him. Anyone else would have been satisfied with it but he wanted something even better.

The legacy was suitable for his master so if he were to use it, he would most likely stop at the primordial stage. His dao would be the same as his master’s. Surpassing this stage required severing karma but this wouldn’t be possible since he couldn’t surpass his master. Thus, he had to find his own legacy.

“A truly ambitious bear.” Li Qiye smiled and presented the treasure to Thunder Emperor instead.

“This...” She staggered backward and said: “I, I can’t keep it.”

Although she didn’t know what a heavenly treasure was, Xian Shen used it for rebirth. This was a testament to its greatness. Moreover, more powerful characters would covet it, ultimately leading to her demise.

“It’s not for you but rather, for all of Golden Lamp. It will conceal and keep them safe.” Li Qiye said.

She wasn’t quite sure of what he meant by the concealment.

“You don’t have to do it, it will do so automatically. Remember, it’s not meant to hide what you want.” He smiled.

“I’m afraid I lack the ability.” She hesitated.

“You have chosen to walk on this path. Your heart is firm and you will be successful because of it.” He said.

She took a deep breath and kneeled, raising both hands to accept it: “I will not forget.”

“Let’s go.” Li Qiye said after giving her the treasure.

After leaving Xian Shen’s world, they saw the core of Golden Lamp again with the radiant primordial tree.

She noticed the cracks leading to Xian Shen’s world closing at a slow pace.

“The new world will be separated?” She asked.

“Heavenrealm is one, there are just many paths. All the minor worlds are part of it, not outside.” Li Qiye said: “As long as one has the coordinates and enough strength, they can reach it without being suppressed by the high heaven’s isolating power.”

“I see.” She understood.

“Stygian and other major worlds are all within the high heaven’s jurisdiction. This will only change if a more powerful immortal appears to create a different seal.” He continued.

“What about the legendary nine worlds and thirteen continents?” She asked.

“You know about them.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Yes, and it would be a great fortune to visit those places.” She said, having a favorable impression because of Immortal Emperor Min Ren.

She heard stories about how he and his allies fought to the end against Mang, allowing Golden Lamp to survive.

Although she had never left Golden Lamp, she fantasized about visiting these unknown worlds.

“Those worlds are a different story, difficult to get to.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Why is that?” She asked curiously.

“They’re actually outside of Heavenrealm. The isolation barriers will obliterate you.” The bear answered.

“Are they bigger than Heavenrealm?” She asked.

“No, they might be bigger than the minor worlds, but any world here is a thousand times better.” The bear shook his head.

“What?” This astounded her since many great immortals came from there. She assumed these worlds were on the same level as the nine major worlds.

“If they are so common, why are there barriers?” She asked.

“Because they are seeds.” Li Qiye answered with a mysterious smile.
